description.value: Bynns Subs is a neighbourhood sandwich and coffee counter on Dunbar Street in Vancouver, serving ciabatta subs alongside espresso drinks and drip coffee. The shop has a customer-satisfaction guarantee and runs a weekly raffle for regulars, giving it a community-café feel. It sits along a residential cycling corridor in the Dunbar neighbourhood.
